items.title: Bob Coquille Interview, 1978-11-20
items.q: Well, I'm sure if my Uncle Walter would have had a chance to get a necktie like that, he'd have probably worn it all the time.

ctx.x: Well, I'm sure if my Uncle Walter would have had a chance to get a necktie like that, he'd have probably worn it all the time. Oh, sure.

Well... That's pretty good. You know, something that occurred to me that most people don't ask about, maybe they don't think about things like this, but it strikes me that there's a difference between bands. Some play very clean and some play very rough. Now, playing with the kind of bands you did, what kind of bands do you like?
